summary: BRT Apartments Corp. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting that its board authorized replenishment of the stock repurchase program, increasing authorized repurchases to $10 million. No price per share, premium, expiration date, or advisor was named. Separately, BRT amended its VNB New York credit facility, cutting the rate to three-month term SOFR plus 210 bps (from 250 bps), lowering the minimum rate to 5% (from 6%) and the adjustable cap rate to 6.25%, with $40 million available. Watch repurchase pace versus trading liquidity and no stated 10b5-1 plan.
